page.content:
Arthur's kinsman who usurps the realm and dies with him.

How Mordred connects

  • Character: King Arthur — Mordred usurps Arthur and faces him at Camlann.
  • Event: Battle of Camlann — Mordred is slain at Camlann as he wounds Arthur.
  • Faction: Round Table — Mordred sits at the Table before he breaks the realm.

What is Mordred?

Mordred — nephew or son, depending on the teller — seizes the kingdom while Arthur is abroad, accuses the queen, and meets Arthur at Camlann, where both are struck down.

Key threads lead to King Arthur, Battle of Camlann and Round Table.
